description: This file defines the PolicyQueryCommandResponseAdapter class, which adapts PolicyQueryCommandResponse objects for use within a protocol, mapping them to and from an Adaptable format. It includes a factory method for instantiation and overrides a method to specify response criterion.

classes.name: PolicyQueryCommandResponseAdapter
classes.description: A final class that extends AbstractPolicyAdapter for PolicyQueryCommandResponse and implements QueryCommandResponseAdapter, providing methods to instantiate and define response criteria.

methods.name: PolicyQueryCommandResponseAdapter
methods.description: Constructor initializing the adapter with mapping strategies and signal mappers, accepting a HeaderTranslator.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method to create a new instance of PolicyQueryCommandResponseAdapter with a given HeaderTranslator.

methods.name: getTypeCriterionAsString
methods.description: Overridden method returning a string criterion for response topic filtering.
